content.comment_body: Hello everyone, is it possible to insert additional symbols into the symbol table for the Message text function? I believe it's not feasible, but I wanted to ask anyway.
Hi there, are you referring to the symbol table in [product_name]? Could you provide more details?

Hello! Yes, you can do this in [product_name], where it's possible to include a tag with a changing value in the text of an alarm message. The displayed value in the message will reflect the tag used at the time the alarm or event occurs. Are you using [product_name] or [product_name] Flexible?

This is a [product_name] discussion, not related to [product_name] classic. Why ask about [product_name] Manager here? Back to the main topic—no, it's not possible to copy message texts with extra symbols. Only the predefined ones are allowed. You might be able to use certain special characters by changing the character set. There were suggestions in the German section of the forum to change the input language for specific formula signs such as Greek letters.
Attached is an example using formula symbols (Greek letters). 1. Set the [product_name] character set to "GBK". 2. Adjust your PC's keyboard to Greek language.
Are you interested in the bonus campaign or prices? I'm just trying to help. It's not a big deal, please think before commenting. Maybe you are an expert.
Please read the thread before responding. This is a [product_name] discussion.
[product_name] Soft Comfort includes a symbol table—see the attached image. Let's remain patient and collaborative so we can learn and support each other. Keep smiling!
The original post is clear. The question is about whether additional icons can be added to the existing ones, and that isn't possible.
Look at the lower part of the image—hex and decimal character codes might be helpful. You can try converting symbols to hex codes and then applying them; maybe it will work.
Hi, certain symbols are supported by [product_name] Soft Comfort, but you can't add more custom symbols to it. Hope this helps.
Sorry, I was referring to the symbol table for Message text in [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no].
Okay, I understand now. Thank you.
Could someone explain how to create a new symbol by entering a hexadecimal value, or any other method? This is new to me and I want to learn more about it.
Maybe the attached photo will help clarify things.

Maybe the attached photo helps clarify things, [user_name]. But does that actually solve the issue of adding new symbols? The image just shows the HEX value of the selected icon—it doesn't let you create icons by entering HEX values. I already knew this; I thought the conversation was about inserting new symbols.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are discussing whether it's possible to add new symbols to the symbol table within the Message text function of [product_name] Soft Comfort. The primary limitation is that custom symbols cannot be added, and users are limited to the options provided by the software. Some alternative suggestions include converting symbols to hex codes or changing character sets or keyboard languages, but these workarounds do not enable full customization.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope for the ability to add or create new symbols in the symbol table for Message text, allowing more flexible and personalized message customization.
